convoLines.text: "I'm going hungry — do you have anything to eat? Anything at all? My hands shake when I try to work."
"I haven't eaten right in days. I'm slowing down — stupid, clumsy. Help me get back on my feet."
They are out on the road, miles from here. Find them when they are back.
"Forget I said anything. What did you want?"
"a cellar full of jars — I'll show you on the map sometime. It's real."
"Good question." "I dreamed Paisley was still here. Woke up angry at the dream. Stupid."
"I pace while thinking. It doesn't bring anyone back. It just keeps my hands from shaking."
"A name. Okay." You say it out loud, trying the shape of it:
🤝 "The Company." It hangs in the air a moment — then Ethan grins. It's real now. It has a name, which means it can be lost.
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
🤝 Ethan is 👁️ Scout now. Sees trouble first. Warns the party on the road.
"Nobody says Paisley's name right yet. We will. Give it a few days."
"Still on what's been happening."
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
"...Think about it? I'll be around."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"Did you leave someone behind? ...Sorry. You don't have to answer that. That means something."
Just: "Yeah." A long quiet. "Me too."
"Still on who you left behind."
"Walk with me? I want another pair of eyes on something."
Tafat shows you where they go to think. "Don't tell the others. Everyone needs one place."
"Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"
"You want to know about that? Okay." "Paisley always took the burnt piece. Said someone had to. I take it now."
"I keep turning over the last thing Paisley said to me. I can't tell if I'm remembering it right, and that's somehow the worst part."
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
Ethan nods, stepping back. "Scout is yours now." (Roles are promises. There's only one of each.)
"So." They look at the fire for a moment.
"Alright — I should get back to it."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"This was good." They mean it.
"Never mind the food I needed — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"
"Saw things with too many joints. Give them room. That's the whole lesson."
"No, really — it's handled. Thanks for asking, though."
They hear the warmth in it. They're not ready to let it in.
They fill the quiet. "Anyway — where was I?"
"Sure. I'll be around."
"We never finished talking about what's been happening — we left it mid-thought, 3 days back. 'A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.'"
"Walk with me? I want another pair of eyes on something."
It's quiet at the tree line. Tafat doesn't say much. Sometimes that's the whole point.
"We bury, we grieve, we keep going. There's no step four."
They nod slowly, not quite done, not quite continuing.
"Still on what's been happening. That's my read."
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
🤝 Tafat is 👁️ Scout now. Sees trouble first. Warns the party on the road.
"Yeah? What's up?"
"Huh. Let me think about that." "You're family now. Chosen family — the kind that actually counts." "That's where we are."
"I should go. You know where to find me."
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."
"Help me haul something back? Too much for one."
Ella shows you where they go to think. "Don't tell the others. Everyone needs one place."
"Heh. Nobody's asked me that in a while. ...I'm alright. Getting there."
"Arturo is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
"I work alone. Nothing personal. ...It's a little personal."
"Sleep's gone strange. I write everything down at odd hours now. Whatever gets me to morning."
You show them Hickory Nuts — where it grows, how to tell it apart. Their eyes widen. "I never knew that."
"The fire feels smaller without Arturo. The rest of us will have to be bigger."
"Funny thing: Still on what's been happening."
"Alright — I should get back to it."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"Thanks for... you know. Just listening."
"This was good." They mean it.
"I don't know what to do with my hands today."
They shake their head, then nod — both true at once. "Talk to me a bit. That helps more than anything."
"Since Arturo died... I keep expecting to see Arturo at the fire. Stupid."
"Someone should watch your back. Might as well be me."
"I keep turning over the last thing Arturo said to me. I can't tell if I'm remembering it right, and that's somehow the worst part."
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
Tafat nods, stepping back. "Scout is yours now." (Roles are promises. There's only one of each.)
"Nobody says Arturo's name right yet. We will. Give it a few days."
"Still on what's been happening."
You show them Blackberry — where it grows, how to tell it apart. "Huh." They turn it over in their mind. "I'll remember that one."
"Alright, love. Go do what you need to do."
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
"Thanks for... you know. Just listening."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"They'd tell me to keep working. So I'm working. That's the whole plan. Let's move."
"Come see what I found. You won't believe it."
Sofia has been stockpiling where nobody looks. "Take half. You've got the hands for it." (+4 wood, +4 fiber to the village stash.)
"Bottom line: Thanks. ...Thanks for saying that."
"Arturo owed me a favor. I keep thinking about collecting. Stupid."
"I don't know you well enough for that. Ask me again when we've survived something together."
You show them Blackberry — where it grows, how to tell it apart. They nod slowly, committing it to memory. "Good to know. Really good to know."
"I should go. Before I overthink this conversation too."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"Thanks for... you know. Just listening."
"This was good." They mean it.
"Can we talk?" Pamela doesn't wait for an answer. "We need to discuss how things are run here."
"Come see what I found. You won't believe it."
Halfway to the hollow, Pamela freezes. Fresh tracks — big. "We go back now. Quietly." You do. The wild, reminding you.
"a spring that runs clear — I'll show you on the map sometime. It's real."
"I can help — I'm not okay. I'm saying it out loud so it's real: I'm not okay."
They pat the ground beside them. "Here. It's dry."
"Here's the thing: It helps. Just — saying it out loud to someone who's actually listening. It helps."
"Still on that hard time."
"...Fine. This had better be worth it."
"Go. But sit with what I said."
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
"Thanks for... you know. Just listening."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."

lines: d30: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Paisley Schulze is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d30: 🕯️ Paisley Schulze is dead — a stranger. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d30: What Paisley kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d30: "Paisley's gone." Ethan looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Paisley." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d30: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Arturo blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d30: 📖 LEARNED: Swimmer (Level 1). Cross water freely. Rivers are roads to you.
d30: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d30: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d30: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d30: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d30: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d30: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Paisley Schulze, 30 days. The mantle passes to Arturo Simon.
d30: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Arturo Simon, 29 — a lifeguard. Their hands know different work now: Night Eyes, Lucky Rock.
d30: The village's quarrel was with Paisley — and Paisley is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d30: At the grave, Pamela, Tafat, Ethan and 2 more speak for Arturo — "Paisley trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d30: The fire knew Arturo before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Arturo Simon is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d42: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d42: 🕯️ Arturo Simon is dead — dehydration. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d42: What Arturo kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d42: "Arturo's gone." Ella looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Arturo." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d42: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Ethan blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

d42: ★ The record corrects itself: this was never Prickly Pear — it's Ghost Pipe. someone taught you wrong (their own memory). (The Codex marks the disagreement. You can call them out in conversation.)
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Debris Shelter (Level 1). A lean-to of branches and leaves beats nothing. Dead air is insulation.
d42: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Arturo Simon, 42 days. The mantle passes to Ethan Hunt.
d42: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Ethan Hunt, 29 — a trail crew lead. His hands know different work now: Night Eyes, Echo Location, Berserker Rage.
d42: The village's quarrel was with Arturo — and Arturo is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d42: You knew Arturo — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting them, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
d42: At the grave, Pamela, Ella, Boris and 1 more speak for Ethan — "Arturo trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d42: The fire knew Ethan before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
